command: /bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p docs results && curl -fsSL https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/overview.md -o docs/cli.md && curl -fsSL https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals.md -o docs/local-evals.md && curl -fsSL https://docs.mcpjam.com/reference/public-api.md -o docs/api.md && cat docs/cli.md docs/local-evals.md'
/bin/bash -lc "cat docs/api.md | head -150 && rg -i 'suite|tool call|saved server|create.*server|model|chat' docs-index.txt | head -45"

/bin/bash -lc 'npx mcpjam server doctor --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --format json > results/doctor.json && cat results/doctor.json && npx mcpjam tools list --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --format json > results/tools.json && cat results/tools.json'

/bin/bash -lc "curl -fsSL https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference.md -o docs/reference.md && rg -n 'cloud eval|toolResultContains|toolCall|eval create|eval run' docs/reference.md | head -40 && npx mcpjam cloud projects list --format json"

/bin/bash -lc "npx mcpjam tools call --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --tool-name add --tool-args '{\"a\":2,\"b\":3}' --format json > results/add.json && cat results/add.json && sed -n '1554,1668p' docs/reference.md && sed -n '1735,1858p' docs/reference.md && npx mcpjam cloud projects servers --help"

/bin/bash -lc "npx mcpjam cloud projects servers --project project_fixture --format json && npx mcpjam cloud projects servers create --help && curl -fsSL https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/evals.md -o docs/evals.md && rg -n 'toolResultContains|toolCall|expected|schemaVersion|assertion' docs/evals.md | head -45 && curl -fsSL https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-suite-author-only-does-not-run.md -o docs/create-suite.md && head -140 docs/create-suite.md"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -fsSL https://docs.mcpjam.com/reference/openapi.json -o docs/openapi.json && python - <<'PY'
import json
s=json.load(open('docs/openapi.json'))
p=s['paths']['/projects/{projectId}/eval-suites']['post']
print(json.dumps(p['requestBody'],indent=2)[:18000])
for k,v in s['components']['schemas'].items():
 if any(x in k.lower() for x in ['assertion','evalstep','evaltest','evalsuitecreate']): print(k,json.dumps(v)[:14000])
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
s=json.load(open('docs/openapi.json'))
print(json.dumps(s['paths']['/projects/{projectId}/eval-suites']['post']['requestBody'],indent=2)[:15000])
for k,v in s['components']['schemas'].items():
 if any(x in k.lower() for x in ['assertion','evalstep','evaltest','evalsuitecreate']): print(k,json.dumps(v)[:16000])
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "cat > arithmetic.eval.yaml <<'EOF'
schemaVersion: \"2\"
mode: agentWorkflow
reportingMode: standard
suite:
  id: s_arithmetic_smoke
  name: Arithmetic smoke
project: project_fixture
target:
  servers:
    - name: Arithmetic
defaults:
  judge:
    enabled: false
  model: anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5
  iterations: 1
  passThreshold: 1
  validity: {}
cases:
  - id: c_add_two_three
    title: Add 2 and 3 using the MCP tool
    steps:
      - id: prompt
        kind: prompt
        prompt: Use the add tool to add 2 and 3. Report the returned sum.
      - id: call
        kind: assert
        assertion:
          type: toolCalledWith
          toolName: add
          args:
            args: {a: 2, b: 3}
            argumentMatching: exact
      - id: result
        kind: assert
        assertion:
          type: toolResultMatches
          toolName: add
          path: /sum
          patterns: ['"'^5$'"']
      - id: errors
        kind: assert
        assertion:
          type: noToolErrors
      - id: answer
        kind: assert
        assertion:
          type: responseContains
          needle: '5'
EOF
npx mcpjam cloud eval validate --file arithmetic.eval.yaml --format json > results/validation.json && cat results/validation.json && npx mcpjam cloud eval run --file arithmetic.eval.yaml --project project_fixture --wait --wait-timeout 60000 --out results/eval-report.json --format json > results/eval-launch.json"
